title: Interpret as area
text: A definite integral of a nonnegative function is the area under its graph. Sketch the graph and identify the shape.

title: Big triangle minus missing piece
text: The full triangle on [-3,3] has area $$9$$. The interval [-2,3] leaves out the small triangle on [-3,-2], which has base $$1$$ and height $$1$$, so area $$\frac{1}{2}$$. The integral is $$9-\frac{1}{2}=\frac{17}{2}$$.
